notes.title: New Game + Alive Updates?!
notes.notes:
[h1]Announcing - No Such Luck![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43396312/ada5b67198f59d3b88d2ad23ebb16ee66e310ce6.jpg[/img]

Hey all! A few announcements I wanted to make. First up - A new game! No Such Luck will release in Early Access in February. The EA version of the game already has significantly more content than Alive, and more is to come! You can wishlist it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3019400/No_Such_Luck

Next up: Alive!

[h2]Remaster![/h2]

That's right - a full remaster of Alive is coming. This will include a full graphical rework of the game, some improved functionality, as well as... that's right, new content! I'm not going to go into too much detail on the new content just yet - we're too early in the process for that, I'll have more details closer to release. In the meantime a full remaster of Alive is now underway! Unfortunately this will take time - my priority is on the new game (No Such Luck) so the remaster is something that is going to be done slowly over time. The entire process will likely take a year or so - but once it's completed, the game will receive a nice new coat of paint, and some new content to go with it! 

That's it for now - More info will be available via the Alive Community Hub once the process progresses a bit, and via announcements when we're closer to completion. I don't have an ETA on any of the Alive remaster work yet, as mentioned it will take a while, but in the meantime feel free to check out No Such Luck!

notes.title: Walkthrough DLC Now available!
notes.notes:
Today the walkthrough DLC for Alive is available for purchase. The DLC acts as a mod for the game. When first installed, you'll get a brief description of how it works (This will only show the first time the DLC is installed).

Once you've installed the DLC you can check your options menu and you should see this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43396312/4d0e42c7629a1f2275c35efebe8e98f2d43fc3fe.png[/img]

This lets you swap between the Full walkthrough, Basic mode, and turning it off entirely. 

At the top right of your screen you'll see "Achievement Guide". Opening it up, and you should see this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43396312/f5cd7dd02ae338cebfd8577fb30bb28ecfe01dd9.png[/img]
(Note: Text is blurred here to avoid spoilers, it's obviously not so in-game.)

Not every achievement is listed, but the more difficult ones provide a step by step guide on how to get them. This also in many cases doubles as an ending guide - as many endings have associated achievements. 

The guide can also be accessed midgame vis the quick menu, here:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43396312/93401d37e30fbcf15751bf4613e6a27f6b926f8b.png[/img]

When playing with the full walkthrough mode on, you'll have screen popups at or before most choices, like this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43396312/7a04047dfe3a82cd35e8b56a7fb9874c2b438eb3.png[/img]

When playing with only Basic mode, the screen popup will not appear, but the color coding of the choices will. Generally green is good, red is bad. 

Note: Not all choices are color-coded. This happens in one of two occasions: #1 The choice is entirely flavor based, and only causes slightly different dialogue in scene. It has no other effect.
#2 The choice is an important one, that causes a distinct story branch. Because the choices are neither "good" nor "Bad" but simply cause the story to branch in different ways, they are not color coded - HOWEVER if you turn on the full walkthrough mode, you will still be able to see an explanation of what outcomes may occur as a result of either choice.

IMPORTANT NOTE: The Full walkthrough mode is *extremely* spoiler heavy, and is not recommended for first time playthroughs. There are pretty heavy spoilers, even right from the very beginning. 

Playing with Full walkthrough mode on, plus the associated achievement guide however, should enable you to get every possible ending, as well as every achievement - particularly the more difficult ones! Enjoy!
